llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create the root navigator with `createDrawerNavigator` from `@react-navigation/drawer`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createDrawerNavigator is imported from @react-navigation/drawer and called to create RootDrawer.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must register both `Account` and `Help` as drawer screen routes in the drawer navigator config.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both Account and Help are registered as screens in the createDrawerNavigator config under the screens object.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must build navigation from the drawer tree via `createStaticNavigation(...)` and render that navigation component from `App`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createStaticNavigation(RootDrawer) produces Navigation, which is rendered as <Navigation /> inside the App component.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Navigation is constructed using the static API: createDrawerNavigator with a config object and createStaticNavigation wrapping it.
